# <span class="en">Impact on existing stations</span><span class="zh">对既有车站的影响</span> {#sec-impact}

## <span class="en">Who loses, and how far it reaches</span><span class="zh">谁受损，影响能到多远</span> {#sec-impact-loss}

::: {.en}
For an existing station the model is used only for a ratio, the station's expected ridership on the proposed
network over its expected ridership on today's, separately for each end of the trip. That ratio is applied to what the
station actually carries. A station the model underestimates keeps its real level. Under the closed model
existing stations lose `r n_fmt(TT$existing_loss[1], 0)` tap-ins a day, `r pct(100 * TT$existing_loss[1] / TT$base[1])` of today's total, against the
`r n_fmt(TT$new_stations[1], 0)` the new stations carry. The two would be nearly equal in the model's own units; they differ here
because each station's loss is proportional to what it really carries rather than to what the model assigned it.
:::

::: {.zh}
对既有车站，模型只用于一个比值：车站在拟建网络上的预期客流与在当前网络上的预期客流之比，按出行两端分别计算，再把这个比值乘到车站的实际客流上。模型低估的车站仍保持其真实水平。在封闭模型下，既有车站每日损失 `r n_fmt(TT$existing_loss[1], 0)` 次进站，占当前总量的 `r pct(100 * TT$existing_loss[1] / TT$base[1])`，而新站承载
`r n_fmt(TT$new_stations[1], 0)` 次。两者在模型自身的单位中应当几乎相等；这里有差异，是因为每个车站的损失与其实际客流成比例，而不是与模型分配给它的客流成比例。
:::

```{r}
#| label: fig-impact
#| fig-cap: "<span class='en'>Change in daily tap-ins at existing stations under the closed model. Red loses, blue gains. Orange points are the new access points.</span><span class='zh'>封闭模型下既有车站每日进站量的变化。红色为减少，蓝色为增加。橙色点为新进站点。</span>"
#| fig-height: 6
#| code-fold: true

ot <- OT |> mutate(ch_cl = pmax(pmin(chg_closed, .5), -.6))
lab <- OT |> slice_min(chg_closed, n = 10)
lab2 <- OT |> filter(role == "existing, gains a line", chg_closed > .1)
map_base(
  net_layer(), new_layer(.5),
  geom_point(data = NT, aes(x, y), size = 1.1, colour = PAL$new),
  geom_point(data = ot, aes(x, y, fill = ch_cl, size = abs(abs_closed)), shape = 21, colour = "#78716c", stroke = .15),
  geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(x, y, label = paste0(station_name, " ", chg(chg_closed))), size = 2.5, min.segment.length = 0,
                  segment.size = .2, seed = 8, box.padding = .45, max.overlaps = 30),
  geom_text_repel(data = lab2, aes(x, y, label = paste0(station_name, " ", chg(chg_closed))), size = 2.5, min.segment.length = 0,
                  segment.size = .2, seed = 9, box.padding = .45, colour = "#1d4ed8")
) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = PAL_LINE, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = RAMP_DIV, limits = c(-.6, .6), labels = percent, name = "Change") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 6, labels = comma, name = "Tap-ins gained\nor lost a day", breaks = c(2000, 8000, 20000))
```

::: {.interp .en}
**The cost falls on the western stations the Jurong Region Line runs beside.** Pioneer, Lakeside, Chinese Garden and Joo Koon lose
more than half their tap-ins, and Boon Lay and Bukit Batok more than a third, because the residents of Jurong West and
Bukit Batok West who walk or bus to them today, and at Joo Koon the workers of the industrial estates, would gain a nearer station. The largest absolute loss
is at `r OT$station_name[which.min(OT$abs_closed)]`, about `r rnd(-min(OT$abs_closed), 1000)` a day. Along the Cross Island Line the effect is milder, about a fifth at
Kovan, Mayflower and Tampines East. Read these as upper bounds. They come from the closed model, which credits every new
rider to an existing station, and the open model reduces most of them by a few points. Changi Airport's
`r chg(stn("Changi Airport", "chg_closed"))` should not be taken at face value: its tap-ins are air passengers and airport staff, not nearby residents,
so applying a ratio from the local market overstates its loss.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**代价落在裕廊区域线沿线的西部车站。** Pioneer、Lakeside、Chinese Garden 与 Joo Koon 损失一半以上的进站量，Boon Lay 与 Bukit Batok 损失三分之一以上，因为今天步行或乘公交前往这些车站的裕廊西与武吉巴督西居民，以及 Joo Koon 工业区的工人，将有一个更近的车站。绝对损失最大的是
`r OT$station_name[which.min(OT$abs_closed)]`，每日约 `r rnd(-min(OT$abs_closed), 1000)` 次。跨岛线沿线的影响较温和，Kovan、Mayflower 与 Tampines East 约为五分之一。这些数字应视为上限：它们来自封闭模型，该模型把每位新乘客都算作来自既有车站，开放模型会使其中多数减少几个百分点。Changi Airport 的
`r chg(stn("Changi Airport", "chg_closed"))` 不应照字面理解：其进站者是航空旅客与机场员工，而不是附近居民，所以套用本地市场的比值高估了它的损失。
:::

```{r}
#| label: fig-fade
#| fig-cap: "<span class='en'>Change in daily tap-ins against distance to the nearest new access point. The line is the median in each distance band. Existing stations that gain a line are in blue.</span><span class='zh'>每日进站量变化与到最近新进站点距离的关系。折线为各距离带的中位数。增加线路的既有车站为蓝色。</span>"
#| fig-height: 3.6
#| code-fold: true

mids <- c(.5, 1.5, 2.5, 4, 6.5, 10)
bd <- SC$by_distance |> mutate(km = mids[seq_len(n())])
ggplot(OT, aes(km_new, chg_closed)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = PAL$grey_l) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = role == "existing, gains a line", size = daily_in), alpha = .65) +
  geom_line(data = bd, aes(km, median_chg), colour = PAL$ink, linewidth = .7) +
  geom_point(data = bd, aes(km, median_chg), colour = PAL$ink, size = 1.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#1d4ed8", `FALSE` = PAL$new), guide = "none") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 4.5, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(x = "Distance to nearest new access point (km)", y = "Change in daily tap-ins") +
  theme_th(10)
```

::: {.interp .en}
**The effect is local, and fades to nothing where it should.** Within 2 km of a new station the median existing station
loses about a fifth of its tap-ins (`r chg(SC$by_distance$median_chg[1])` under 1 km, `r chg(SC$by_distance$median_chg[2])` from 1 to 2 km). By 3 to 5 km it has fallen to
`r chg(SC$by_distance$median_chg[4])`, by 5 to 8 km `r chg(SC$by_distance$median_chg[5], 1)`, and beyond 8 km it is effectively zero. Of the `r nrow(OT)` existing stations,
`r sum(OT$chg_closed < -.05)` lose more than 5%, and `r sum(OT$km_new > 5)` are more than 5 km from anything new. An earlier version of this model, with no limit on
access, gave stations 8 to 12 km away a median loss of about 10% (§6.2), which shows why this picture had to be checked as well as
the fit. The spread within a band is large, because a station's loss depends on how much of its market lies toward the
new station and on how many alternatives are nearby.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**影响是局部的，并在该消失的地方消失。** 在新站 2 公里内，既有车站的进站量中位数损失约五分之一（1 公里内 `r chg(SC$by_distance$median_chg[1])`，1 至 2 公里 `r chg(SC$by_distance$median_chg[2])`）。到 3 至 5 公里降至 `r chg(SC$by_distance$median_chg[4])`，5 至 8 公里 `r chg(SC$by_distance$median_chg[5], 1)`，8 公里以外实际上为零。在 `r nrow(OT)` 个既有车站中，
`r sum(OT$chg_closed < -.05)` 个损失超过 5%，`r sum(OT$km_new > 5)` 个距任何新站超过 5 公里。此前不限制到达距离的模型版本曾让 8 至 12 公里外的车站损失中位数约 10%（§6.2），这说明除了拟合度，这样的图也必须检查。同一距离带内差异很大，因为车站的损失取决于其市场有多少位于新站方向，以及附近还有多少替代选择。
:::

```{r}
#| label: tbl-losers
#| tbl-cap: "<span class='en'>Largest proportional losses among existing stations. The 90% range is the closed model's; the open column is the alternative in §10.1.</span><span class='zh'>既有车站中比例损失最大者。90% 范围来自封闭模型；开放列为 §10.1 的替代模型。</span>"
#| echo: false

OT |>
  arrange(chg_closed) |>
  head(12) |>
  transmute(Station = station_name, `Today` = daily_in, `After, closed` = E_closed, Change = chg_closed,
            `90% low` = lo_closed / daily_in - 1, `90% high` = hi_closed / daily_in - 1, `Change, open` = chg_open,
            `Km to new station` = km_new, `Home share` = phi) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(c(Today, `After, closed`), decimals = 0) |>
  fmt_percent(c(Change, `90% low`, `90% high`, `Change, open`), decimals = 0) |>
  fmt_percent(`Home share`, decimals = 0) |>
  fmt_number(`Km to new station`, decimals = 1) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12.5))
```

## <span class="en">Stations that gain a line</span><span class="zh">增加线路的车站</span> {#sec-impact-gain}

::: {.en}
For the seven stations gaining a line, the answer depends on an assumption the data can barely test. The model
estimates that each extra line multiplies a station's pull by about `r num(exp(ch(RP$coef_H, "ic")), 1)`, but that comes from comparing stations,
and interchanges tend to be in town centres. Whether adding a line to an existing station has the same effect is not something
three months of data can show. @tbl-gains therefore gives both ends.
:::

::: {.zh}
对增加线路的七个车站，答案取决于一个数据几乎无法检验的假设。模型估计每多一条线路，车站吸引力约变为 `r num(exp(ch(RP$coef_H, "ic")), 1)` 倍，但这来自车站之间的比较，而换乘站往往位于市镇中心。给现有车站增加一条线路是否有同样效果，三个月的数据无法说明。因此 @tbl-gains 给出了两端的结果。
:::

```{r}
#| label: tbl-gains
#| tbl-cap: "<span class='en'>Tap-ins at existing stations gaining a line, with and without the interchange uplift. Transfers are added in §10.2 and are not tap-ins.</span><span class='zh'>增加线路的既有车站的进站量，分别考虑与不考虑换乘提升。换乘在 §10.2 中另行增加，不属于进站量。</span>"
#| echo: false

OT |>
  filter(role == "existing, gains a line") |>
  arrange(desc(daily_in)) |>
  transmute(Station = station_name, Today = daily_in, `With uplift` = chg_closed, `No uplift` = chg_noup, `With uplift, open` = chg_open) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(Today, decimals = 0) |>
  fmt_percent(c(`With uplift`, `No uplift`, `With uplift, open`), decimals = 0) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12.5))
```

::: {.en}
The sign changes at five of them. Ang Mo Kio moves from `r chg(stn("Ang Mo Kio", "chg_noup"))` to `r chg(stn("Ang Mo Kio", "chg_closed"))`, Hougang from
`r chg(stn("Hougang", "chg_noup"))` to `r chg(stn("Hougang", "chg_closed"))`. Only Boon Lay and Jurong East fall on both, because the Jurong Region Line's stations take so much of their
catchments. The honest conclusion is that tap-ins at these seven stations are not reliably predicted in either direction, and that the
more certain change there is in transfers, which @sec-va-mci takes up.
:::

::: {.zh}
其中五个车站的符号会改变。Ang Mo Kio 从 `r chg(stn("Ang Mo Kio", "chg_noup"))` 变为 `r chg(stn("Ang Mo Kio", "chg_closed"))`，Hougang 从 `r chg(stn("Hougang", "chg_noup"))` 变为 `r chg(stn("Hougang", "chg_closed"))`。只有 Boon Lay 与 Jurong East 在两种情形下都下降，因为裕廊区域线的车站取走了它们太多的集散范围。实事求是的结论是：这七个车站的进站量无论朝哪个方向都无法可靠预测，更确定的变化在于换乘，@sec-va-mci 将讨论这一点。
:::

## <span class="en">Market areas</span><span class="zh">市场区</span> {#sec-impact-market}

```{r}
#| label: fig-share
#| fig-cap: "<span class='en'>Share of each hexagon's home-end market that the model sends to the new access points. Outlines mark hexagons whose most likely station becomes a new one.</span><span class='zh'>模型把每个六边形的居住端市场分配给新进站点的份额。轮廓线标出最可能使用的车站变为新站的六边形。</span>"
#| fig-height: 5.6
#| code-fold: true

hi <- hex |> select(hex_id) |> inner_join(SC$hex_impact, by = c("hex_id" = "origin")) |> filter(residents > 0)
map_base(
  geom_sf(data = hi, aes(fill = share_new), colour = NA),
  geom_sf(data = filter(hi, to_new), fill = NA, colour = "#44403c", linewidth = .22),
  net_layer("#78716c", .22), new_layer(.5),
  geom_point(data = NT, aes(x, y), size = .9, colour = "white"),
  geom_point(data = NT, aes(x, y), size = .5, colour = PAL$ink)
) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = PAL_LINE, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#fff7ec", "#fdd49e", "#fc8d59", "#d7301f", "#7f0000"), limits = c(0, 1), labels = percent,
                       name = "Share to\nnew stations")
```

::: {.interp .en}
**About one resident in fourteen would have a new first choice, and many more would have a new option.** The dominant
station changes for hexagons holding `r n_fmt(sum(SC$hex_impact$residents[SC$hex_impact$switched]), 0)` residents, and for `r n_fmt(sum(SC$hex_impact$residents[SC$hex_impact$to_new]), 0)` of them
(`r pct(100 * sum(SC$hex_impact$residents[SC$hex_impact$to_new]) / sum(SC$hex_impact$residents))` of all residents) it becomes a new station. These are the outlined hexagons. The shaded
area is wider: `r pct(100 * sum(SC$hex_impact$residents[SC$hex_impact$share_new > .2], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(SC$hex_impact$residents), 0)` of residents live where more than a fifth of the market goes to new stations. The map also shows the
limit of a boundary. Hexagons outside the outline, holding `r rnd(sum(SC$hex_impact$residents[SC$hex_impact$share_new > 1/3 & !SC$hex_impact$to_new], na.rm = TRUE), 1000)` residents, still send more than a third of their market to a new station, which a
nearest-station map would call no change at all. The Huff model's probabilities are what register it.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**约每十四位居民中就有一位的首选车站将变为新站，而有新选择的居民要多得多。** 主导车站发生变化的六边形共有 `r n_fmt(sum(SC$hex_impact$residents[SC$hex_impact$switched]), 0)` 名居民，其中 `r n_fmt(sum(SC$hex_impact$residents[SC$hex_impact$to_new]), 0)` 名（占全部居民的 `r pct(100 * sum(SC$hex_impact$residents[SC$hex_impact$to_new]) / sum(SC$hex_impact$residents))`）的主导车站变为新站，即图中带轮廓线的六边形。阴影范围更广：`r pct(100 * sum(SC$hex_impact$residents[SC$hex_impact$share_new > .2], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(SC$hex_impact$residents), 0)` 的居民所在之处，有超过五分之一的市场流向新站。
这张图也显示了边界的局限。轮廓线之外的六边形中有 `r rnd(sum(SC$hex_impact$residents[SC$hex_impact$share_new > 1/3 & !SC$hex_impact$to_new], na.rm = TRUE), 1000)` 名居民，那里仍有超过三分之一的市场流向新站，而最近车站地图会说这里毫无变化。记录这种变化的正是 Huff 模型的概率。
:::

```{r}
#| label: fig-boundary
#| fig-cap: "<span class='en'>Dominant station areas in the west, before and after the Jurong Region Line. Each colour block is the set of hexagons most likely to use one station; colours repeat and carry no meaning of their own. Black points are stations open today, and orange points are new.</span><span class='zh'>裕廊区域线开通前后西部的主导车站区。每个色块是最可能使用同一车站的六边形集合；颜色重复使用，本身没有含义。黑点为现有车站，橙点为新站。</span>"
#| fig-height: 4.3
#| code-fold: true

west <- c(xmin = 8500, xmax = 24000, ymin = 30500, ymax = 44000)
dom_map <- function(col, title, show_new) {
  d <- hi |> filter(!is.na(.data[[col]])) |> group_by(st = .data[[col]]) |> summarise(.groups = "drop")
  d$k <- factor(((seq_len(nrow(d)) * 7) %% 11) + 1)
  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = land, fill = "#f5f5f4", colour = "#d6d3d1", linewidth = .25) +
    geom_sf(data = d, aes(fill = k), colour = "white", linewidth = .4, alpha = .8, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(data = dE, aes(x, y), size = .9, colour = PAL$ink) +
    { if (show_new) geom_point(data = NT, aes(x, y), size = 1.4, colour = PAL$new) } +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
    coord_sf(datum = NA, expand = FALSE, xlim = west[c("xmin", "xmax")], ylim = west[c("ymin", "ymax")]) +
    labs(title = title) + theme_map(10)
}
dom_map("dominant_old", "Today", FALSE) + dom_map("dominant_new", "With the Jurong Region Line", TRUE)
```

::: {.interp .en}
**The western market areas contract.** Today Boon Lay, Lakeside and Pioneer dominate large areas of Jurong West that are
well beyond walking distance. With the Jurong Region Line those areas divide among Gek Poh, Corporation, Jurong West and Bahar Junction, and Boon Lay's dominant area alone loses
`r n_fmt(-stn("Boon Lay", "dom_change"), 0)` residents. Lakeside loses `r n_fmt(-stn("Lakeside", "dom_change"), 0)`, and Bukit Gombak `r n_fmt(-stn("Bukit Gombak", "dom_change"), 0)`. The
probability-weighted average distance a station's riders travel to reach it falls by `r pct(100 * (1 - median(OT$km_new_net[OT$km_new <= 2] / OT$km_old[OT$km_new <= 2])), 0)` at the median
station within 2 km of a new one: riders who remain live nearer. This is the behaviour hoped for in a transit-oriented
plan, shorter access for the same trip. The price is lower ridership at what are today some of the
west's busier stations.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**西部市场区收缩。** 今天 Boon Lay、Lakeside 与 Pioneer 主导着裕廊西大片超出步行距离的区域。裕廊区域线开通后，这些区域被 Gek Poh、Corporation、Jurong West 与 Bahar Junction 瓜分：仅 Boon Lay 的主导区就减少 `r n_fmt(-stn("Boon Lay", "dom_change"), 0)` 名居民，Lakeside 减少 `r n_fmt(-stn("Lakeside", "dom_change"), 0)` 名，Bukit Gombak 减少 `r n_fmt(-stn("Bukit Gombak", "dom_change"), 0)` 名。
在新站 2 公里内的车站，乘客到达车站的概率加权平均距离中位数下降 `r pct(100 * (1 - median(OT$km_new_net[OT$km_new <= 2] / OT$km_old[OT$km_new <= 2])), 0)`：留下来的乘客住得更近。这正是公共交通导向规划所期望的：同样的出行，更短的到达距离。代价则是今天西部一些较繁忙车站的客流下降。
:::

## <span class="en">How much the answer depends on the choices</span><span class="zh">答案在多大程度上取决于这些选择</span> {#sec-impact-sens}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sens
#| tbl-cap: "<span class='en'>Sensitivity of the headline results. Rank correlation is with the main case across new stations. Near and far are median changes at existing stations within 2 km and beyond 8 km of a new station; far should be zero.</span><span class='zh'>主要结果的敏感性。秩相关是与主情形在新站之间的相关。近与远分别是距新站 2 公里内与 8 公里外的既有车站的变化中位数；远应为零。</span>"
#| echo: false

SN |>
  transmute(Case = case, `New stations` = new_total, JRL = jrl, CRL = crl, `Rank corr.` = rho_new, `Worst existing` = worst_existing,
            Near = near_median, Far = far_median, `Stations losing >5%` = n_over_5) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(c(`New stations`, JRL, CRL), decimals = 0) |>
  fmt_number(`Rank corr.`, decimals = 2) |>
  fmt_percent(c(`Worst existing`, Near, Far), decimals = 0) |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_body(rows = 1)) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))
```

::: {.interp .en}
**The ranking of new stations is firm, and the far-field test separates the specifications.** In every case
but one, the order of new stations correlates with the main case at about 0.88 or better. Totals move more,
from about `r rnd(min(SN$new_total), 1000)` to `r rnd(max(SN$new_total), 1000)` a day. The largest single assumption is how the Jurong Region Line's medium capacity counts: at half the LRT effect
the line drops from `r rnd(SN$jrl[1], 1000)` to `r rnd(SN$jrl[SN$case == "JRL at half the LRT effect"], 1000)`. The 250 m and 1,000 m grids barely change the result
[@openshaw1984], and neither do a larger distance floor or the committed Bedok South, Sungei Bedok and Xilin stations.

The last column but one is the most telling. Three cases give existing stations far from anything new a loss of over 10%:
no maximum distance, a single model of all tap-ins, and exact calibration as in `huff.fit()`. All three have no distance limit, and that is the cause;
exact calibration barely adds to it (`r chg(SN$far_median[grepl("Exact", SN$case)], 1)` against `r chg(SN$far_median[grepl("No maximum", SN$case)], 1)`). Its own fault is different. Reading unexplained
ridership as attractiveness, it stretches Kranji's mean catchment from `r num(RP$cal_tbl$km_structural[RP$cal_tbl$station_name == "Kranji"], 1)` to `r num(RP$cal_tbl$km_calibrated[RP$cal_tbl$station_name == "Kranji"], 1)` km. Existing stations
are therefore pivoted rather than calibrated.
:::

::: {.interp .zh}
**新站排序很稳健，远场检验则能区分不同设定。** 除一种情形外，新站排序与主情形的相关都在 0.88 以上。总量变化更大，从每日约 `r rnd(min(SN$new_total), 1000)` 到 `r rnd(max(SN$new_total), 1000)` 次。最大的单一假设是如何看待裕廊区域线的中运量：按轻轨效应的一半计算，该线从 `r rnd(SN$jrl[1], 1000)` 降至 `r rnd(SN$jrl[SN$case == "JRL at half the LRT effect"], 1000)`。250 米与 1,000 米网格几乎不改变结果 [@openshaw1984]，较大的距离下限以及已确定的 Bedok South、Sungei Bedok 与 Xilin 车站也是如此。

倒数第二列最能说明问题。有三种情形让远离新站的既有车站损失超过 10%：不设最大距离、单一全量进站模型，以及 `huff.fit()` 那样的精确校准。这三种都不限制距离，这才是原因；精确校准几乎没有加剧这一点（`r chg(SN$far_median[grepl("Exact", SN$case)], 1)` 对 `r chg(SN$far_median[grepl("No maximum", SN$case)], 1)`）。它自身的问题不同：把未解释的客流读作吸引力，使 Kranji 的平均集散范围从 `r num(RP$cal_tbl$km_structural[RP$cal_tbl$station_name == "Kranji"], 1)` 公里拉长到 `r num(RP$cal_tbl$km_calibrated[RP$cal_tbl$station_name == "Kranji"], 1)` 公里。因此既有车站采用转折基准，而不是精确校准。
:::
